name: What types of baseboard materials are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of baseboard materials are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common baseboard materials include MDF (medium-density fiberboard), pine, and hardwood. MDF is an affordable, smooth option ideal for painting, but it can swell if exposed to moisture. Pine is a popular softwood that is easy to cut and nail, suitable for both painting and staining. Hardwoods like oak or maple are durable and offer a premium finish, often chosen for staining to showcase their natural grain, though they are generally more expensive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include MDF, pine, and hardwoods like oak or maple, each offering different aesthetics, durability, and cost.
